summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing, per Indian Listing Regulations, an Order in Appeal (the local equivalent of an administrative appeal ruling) received October 31, 2026 at 4:45 p.m. from the Additional Commissioner (ST) (Grade-I) (FAC), Telangana, under Section 107 of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017. The OIA confirms a reduced GST penalty of INR 6,95,418, down from the INR 13,55,750 Order in Original disclosed December 30, 2023. The Bank states it will appeal within prescribed timelines. No board recommendation, advisor, or securities terms; immaterial routine tax-litigation disclosure, not a special situation.
